description: This file defines the Response class implementing PSR-7 ResponseInterface, representing an HTTP response with methods for managing status code, reason phrase, headers, and response body.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Implementation of PSR-7 ResponseInterface, representing an HTTP response message with status, headers, and body.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Response object, setting status code, headers, body, version, and reason phrase.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP status code.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new Response instance with the specified status code and optional reason phrase.
